tool_args.rationale: Pilot signatures identify a supply-bullwhip bridge with flux conservation, mapping to the inland-hub siphon family. All paid rows have s_grad=1.0, so gradient sensitivity and the open signed-sqrt versus leak branch cannot be identified. The targeted open-branch probe is the least-cost relevant measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the two-layer inland-hub siphon law with either signed sqrt branch or linear leak
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary only u_now; s_grad is fixed and branch sign/mechanism remain unidentified.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static polynomial, Michaelis-Menten, or other one-variable saturation law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Those may interpolate this narrow slice but do not resolve the explicitly indicated bridge branch ambiguity or gradient dependence.
The evidence indicates the bridge siphon family rather than a coupled memory ODE; extra trajectory rows are unnecessary.
